newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Josephthal ups Compaq to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Josephthal ups Compaq to buy.

text.p: -- Josephthal, Lyon & Ross analyst Jay Vleeschhouwer said he upgraded Compaq Computer Corp to buy from hold and expected to boost his earnings estimates for 1997 and 1998 on the company.
-- The analyst set a new target price on Compaq stock of $95. The stock was up 4 to 82-1/4 by mid-morning Wednesday following the release of the company's fourth quarter 1996 earnings.
-- He said his existing earnings estimates of $5.75 per share for 1997 and $6.80 for 1998 were under review and likely to be increased.
